title: Unit – 5 : Session – 8 : SLO – 1  |  Event-Driven GUI with Tkinter
sections: 1. Create a GUI window — import tkinter as tk; root = tk.Tk(); root.title("My App"); root.geometry("300x150"); root.mainloop().
2. Widget that displays a message — tk.Label (e.g. tk.Label(root, text="Hello").pack()); for pop-ups, tkinter.messagebox.showinfo().
3. Widget that triggers a function on click — tk.Button with the command option: tk.Button(root, text="Go", command=my_func).
